therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Best Overall Response (BOR) as per RECIST 1.1 and Durable Response Rate (DRR)

results.effect_size: Part A: ORR 32.9% (29/88 participants with CR/PR); Part B: DRR 30.2% (95% CI: 22.0–39.4)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Serum concentrations achieved therapeutic levels with CEOI ranging 237-453 μg/mL and Ctrough 22-61 μg/mL
biomarker_changes: Treatment emergent anti-avelumab antibodies: Part A: 3/88 participants, Part B: 8/116 participants
subgroup_findings: Response status at 6 months: Part A 30.7%, Part B 33.6%
Response status at 12 months: Part A 20.7%, Part B 26.7%
safety_signals: Treatment-related TEAEs: Part A 68/88 participants, Part B 94/116 participants
Treatment-related serious TEAEs: Part A 9/88, Part B 17/116
No treatment-related deaths in either part
Common Grade ≥3 lab abnormalities: lymphocyte count decreased (18), hyponatremia (11), hyperglycemia (7)
results.dose_information: 10 mg/kg intravenously every 2 weeks as 1-hour infusion until therapeutic failure, clinical deterioration, or unacceptable toxicity

context.duration: Up to 325 weeks (Part A) and 396 weeks (Part B)
